tasks.title: Review [architecture-agent] Implement Make Review Verification Requests Executable Without Reviewer-Supplied Literal Commands
tasks.description: Review pr-prd-make-review-verification-requests-d5537b-architecture-agent for Implement Make Review Verification Requests Executable Without Reviewer-Supplied Literal Commands
acceptance: Extend review blocker extraction so file-based or suite-based verification requests are normalized into structured executable verification targets
Define a deterministic resolver that maps changed files and reviewer-mentioned test files/areas to one or more runnable commands.
Require implementation follow-ups to execute or explicitly fail the resolved verification command before completion when an open verification blocker exists.
and evidence on the follow-up task so reviewer gating uses structured proof.
Prevent noop completion and reviewer approval when a verification blocker remains unresolved because no command was resolved or executed.
Add fallback behavior for ambiguous requests: mark the blocker unresolved with a clear reason instead of silently accepting noop completion.
